newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Stay of proceedings in Garibaldi poisoning case.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Stay of proceedings in Garibaldi poisoning case.

text.p: A South Australian court has granted a stay of proceedings against three former directors of the Adelaide-based Garibaldi Smallgoods Pty Ltd, charged over the death of a young girl after eating Garibaldi mettwurst.
The three directors - Lou Marchi, Philip Marchi and Neville Mead - successfully applied for the stay, saying they could not afford to properly defend themselves.
A 1995 coronial inquiry found that four-year old Nikki Robinson had died earlier that year after contracting haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS) as a result of eating Garibaldi garlic mettwurst.
